# SRX Global Commits $2.5 Million to Launch Multi-Strategy Trading Platform in Partnership with 5T Trading, Powered by the EMJX Platform


October 08, 2026 8:35am EDT


### New platform to be launched with managers from Millennium Management, Balyasny and Citadel, designed to enable the next generation of proprietary traders under Eric Jackson’s leadership


NORTH PALM BEACH, Fla., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SRX Global Inc. (NYSE American: SRXH) (the “Company” or “SRX”), an AI-enabled platform dedicated to generating long-term shareholder value through investments in high-conviction operating companies and strategic assets, today announced an initial investment of $2.5 million to seed a newly formed multi-strategy trading platform fund.


The new platform was established as a strategic joint venture between SRX's internal EMJX division and 5T Trading.


"Our investment in this multi-strategy trading platform aligns perfectly with SRX's mandate to invest in high-conviction, strategic assets," said Kent Cunningham, Chief Executive Officer of SRX Global. "By partnering with EMJX and 5T Trading, we are backing a world-class infrastructure. We believe that under the combined expertise of Eric Jackson and 5T Trading this platform will become a premier launchpad for elite proprietary traders, ultimately generating significant value for our portfolio."


The primary goal of this multi-strategy trading platform is to cultivate and empower the next generation of proprietary traders. By providing infrastructure and capital backing, the partnership aims to build a thriving ecosystem for future traders to succeed.


Eric Jackson, President, EMJX Platform and Head of Asset Management, added, "Our vision is to build the ultimate ecosystem for the next generation of proprietary traders. By partnering with SRX, EMJX, and 5T Trading, and bringing on a pod approach with experienced managers, we will give future traders the capital, robust infrastructure, and strategic guidance they need to thrive in highly competitive markets. I am incredibly excited to help shape and enable the future of prop trading through this venture."


**About SRX Global Inc.**
SRX Global is an AI-driven platform focused on generating long-term shareholder value through investments in high-conviction operating companies, strategic assets, and technology-enabled opportunities. The Company leverages proprietary technology, data analytics, and disciplined capital allocation to identify and manage investments across multiple sectors.
